Oviparity

Temnospondyls were oviparous, laying eggs on land. There is no evidence of viviparity in temnospondyls, and the eggshells of dissorophids and capitosaur semiaquatic temnospondyls are thick and unpitted, indicating that hatching was non-amniote-like.
